title: Persistent Updates & Crucial Activity Shield (v0.4.5)
message: A required update for GabAI is available. Please update to continue using the application with the latest performance and reliability improvements.
changelog:
• Seamless Update Transition: Fixed splash screen update dialog teardown, anchoring updates securely to active screens
• Crucial Activity Shield: Suppresses update prompts during active quizzes, exams, and camera scanning so work is never lost
• Background & Idle Poller: Automatically detects new app releases while roaming or idle every 3 minutes
• Enforced App Integrity: Modal non-cancellable update policy ensures all users stay on the latest supported release
